descriptionPlain:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. lists.content:
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

This role is based in New York City

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.
You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

lists.content:
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

• You have 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling enterprise software, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals and achieving or exceeding revenue targets.

• You are experienced in strategic account planning, building multi-threaded relationships, and navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

• You have experience selling to technical and executive stakeholders, such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform teams, and DevOps leaders.

• You are familiar with software development, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems, and understand how engineering organizations make buying decisions.

• You are comfortable managing procurement processes, security reviews, and legal negotiations for multi-year agreements.

• You can translate technical value into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, along with a strategic approach to long-term account development.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

This role is based in New York City or San Francisco.

We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

description: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

lists.content:
• Build a deep understanding of Spotify’s label, publishing, lyrics, and audiobook contracts, how they’re implemented in our royalty systems, and how they flow into royalty calculations, downstream datasets, and reporting.
  • Use the team’s internal AI tooling to configure contracts in Spotify’s royalty systems and test financial outputs for accuracy before sign-off from Commercial Accounting.
  • Lead data analyses to answer royalty questions from internal teams such as Legal & Licensing and Finance, and from external partners such as rightsholders and back offices.
  • Support month-end royalty close by reviewing checks, validating calculation outputs, and escalating risks or issues.
  • Run month-end analytics, from generating the data and deck to providing commentary on fluxes, to support Content Accounting’s sign-off on final royalty figures.
  • Help build new capabilities for the team, contributing directly to how our internal AI tooling evolves as Spotify’s business grows.
  • Partner closely with Legal & Licensing, Commercial Accounting, Content Accounting, and Financial Engineering.

• You have a background in Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • You have 1+ years of experience in a data analyst or technical operations role. Experience in a royalty-related role at a record label, digital service provider, or music publisher is a plus.
  • You have strong technical and data analysis skills, such as SQL, Python, BigQuery, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • You bring an AI-first approach to problem-solving and are excited to get hands-on building and evolving internal tooling.
  • You’re curious about royalties and the music industry, and how Spotify pays the people who create content on our platform. Familiarity with label, publisher, or audiobook contracts, or with DSP data files, is a bonus.
  • You’re organized and flexible, and comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • You’re a coachable self-starter who enjoys learning new concepts and coordinating across teams to meet deadlines.
  • You’re detail-oriented with a high bar for accuracy, because our numbers drive real payouts to rightsholders.

This role is based in Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors.
As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization.
In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. 
We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. 
This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

lists.content:
• Build and foster relations with key partners (artists, managers, labels, industry organizations) across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Act as a representative of Spotify externally in the music industry and empower artists and labels with knowledge, insights, and tools they need to succeed on Spotify, acting as their advocate and champion.
  • Music Marketing and culture: Stay ahead of music trends and key moments to proactively identify and activate new music and content opportunities.
  • IRL events and music marketing: Proactively identify and pursue new growth opportunities in areas such as superfan engagement and live events together with cross-functional teams, work together to bring these initiatives to life.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Consumer Marketing, PR and other teams, acting as a representative of the artists & labels you work with.

• You have 2+ years of music industry experience, preferably in an artist & partner-facing role.
  • You have experience and knowledge working in a broad spectrum of culture with a focus on music and content.
  • You have expertise in the electronic music space (preferred)
  • You have a strong understanding of the digital music landscape and streaming platforms.
  • You are an excellent project manager with a track record in leading projects from end to end, including marketing campaigns, live events and cultural activations
  • You have experience in project managing offline to online activations, incl. Working on live events, content capture and digital extensions of those
  • You possess excellent negotiating, presentation and people skills
  • You are comfortable in very fast paced, driven work environments and can do well in a team that moves quickly
  • You are well organized, with the ability to plan and deliver on tight deadlines
  • You're a great teammate, adapt well to change, and have a positive attitude
  • You are fluent in German and English

• This role is based in Berlin, Germany
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come into the office 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology.
We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

lists.content:
• Map the Japanese publishing and audiobook landscape and identify priority publishers, rights holders, and catalogue opportunities.
  • Build a strong pipeline of major and independent publishers, and take partnerships from first conversation through negotiation, agreement, and onboarding.
  • Lead commercial and licensing negotiations, including distribution terms and content licensing budgets, and design creative deal structures that improve economics and share risk.
  • Identify and prioritize the audiobook catalogues and titles that matter most to listeners in Japan, using data, financial models, and market insights.
  • Own long-term publisher relationships, aligning on shared goals and running regular performance reviews informed by data and partner feedback.
  • Partner with operations and publishers on catalogue onboarding, metadata readiness, and smooth content delivery, resolving issues that affect partners or listeners.
  • Represent publishing partners internally, working with product, editorial, growth, operations, and cost management teams on launch priorities and long-term improvements.
  • Stay close to developments in the Japanese publishing and audiobook market and turn them into new partnership and growth opportunities.

• You have full professional proficiency in Japanese and English and can lead complex commercial negotiations in both languages.
  • You have experience in licensing, partnerships, business affairs or business development in digital content, such as books, audiobooks, music, podcasts, video or TV. You have a track record of managing complex commercial relationships with rights holders.
  • Knowledge of the Japanese book publishing and audiobook ecosystem, including publishers, rights holders and distribution models, and an established network in the industry is preferred. 
  • You understand licensing and commercial models between rights holders, and digital platforms, and you’ve led or supported negotiations in a digital content environment.
  • You’re comfortable assessing catalogues, interpreting performance data and financial models, and managing budgets to balance partner value, cost, and long-term growth.
  • You’re a confident, collaborative negotiator who finds solutions that work for both Spotify and its partners.
  • You take ownership, build relationships and opportunities from the ground up, and stay steady in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • You can balance immediate launch priorities with building a sustainable long-term publisher strategy.

• This role is based in Tokyo.
    We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:
• Own the AV experience across EMEA, including meeting rooms, boardrooms, common areas, labs, lounges, and digital signage.
  • Provide thoughtful, high-quality AV support for executive and VIP meetings, helping ensure technology works reliably when it matters most.
  • Design, document, deliver, and maintain AV solutions and technical standards in partnership with the global AV team. Review technical designs and documentation from external integrators to ensure solutions meet requirements.
  • Lead AV initiatives and projects with internal partners and external vendors, from defining scope through delivery, commissioning, and handover.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex AV issues and support incident, problem, and change management when needed.
  • Monitor AV infrastructure and performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and test new solutions that make collaboration easier for team members.
  • Deploy and support AI-powered capabilities across meeting rooms and video conferencing, while using AI tooling to improve areas such as monitoring, reporting, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain AV asset information, contribute to forecasting and budgeting, and create clear technical documentation and training materials.
  • Build strong relationships with vendors, integrators, and internal partners while identifying better ways of working across the team.
  • Share your knowledge with colleagues, support the onboarding of new team members, and continue developing your own AV expertise.

• You have 3+ years of AV experience and have delivered AV projects through design, integration, commissioning, and ongoing support.
  • You understand the hardware behind sophisticated AV systems, including DSP, control processors, amplifiers, and related technologies, with experience using platforms such as Crestron, Q-SYS, and Dante. Experience configuring Q-SYS designs is a plus, as are certifications such as AVIXA CTS, Q-SYS Level 2, or Dante Level 3.
  • You have hands-on experience deploying, managing, and monitoring video conferencing systems such as Google Meet hardware and Zoom Rooms. You're familiar with fleet management and monitoring tools and can troubleshoot issues across connected AV systems.
  • You have experience supporting senior executives or VIPs and can provide thoughtful, professional, and discreet support when priorities are time-sensitive.
  • You understand IT and networking fundamentals, including how AV systems communicate across enterprise networks.
  • You're familiar with technologies such as Dante and Q-SYS, including multicast, QoS, and clocking, and have experience using ticketing or work-management systems such as Jira.
  • You communicate technical information clearly and create documentation that helps others understand, support, and use AV technology effectively.
  • You’re curious about how AI is changing meetings and collaboration and are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to improve how you work.
  • You enjoy getting to the root cause of technical problems and finding solutions that improve the experience over the long term.
  • You work effectively both independently and with distributed teams, communicate clearly with people across different roles and levels, and build trusted relationships with partners and vendors.
  • You take ownership of your work, adapt thoughtfully to changing priorities, and are motivated to keep learning as AV technology evolves.

• This role is based in Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come in 4-5 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next.
These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide.
This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

lists.content:
• Build and Evolve Core Services: Design, build and operate the backend services and APIs behind our data catalog, lineage and publishing systems, and evolve them as the platform adopts new storage technologies and new kinds of data. Hold them to a high bar for correctness, performance and reliability.
  • Build Data Pipelines: Develop and run the batch and streaming pipelines that keep our metadata current, processing platform events and audit logs to capture how data is created and changed, and turning lineage and metadata into data products other teams build on.
  • Own Projects End to End: Turn what the teams using our platform need into technical designs, drive them through delivery and rollout, and own the results once they're in production.
  • Keep the Platform Healthy: Take part in on-call for critical services, build in observability and quality checks by default, and use automation, including AI tooling, to reduce toil for the team and our users.

• You have solid experience building and running backend services and APIs in production with Java, and you care about API design, versioning and backward compatibility.
  • You're comfortable with SQL and have worked with data pipelines or a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks. Hands-on experience with batch or streaming frameworks like Beam, Flink or Spark is a plus.
  • You have a working understanding of data engineering concepts such as orchestration, metadata management, data quality, governance and lineage.
  • You break problems down into clear, shippable steps, reasoning through tradeoffs and risks and converging on clear recommendations.
  • You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance, and you care about operating it well after launch.
  • You are a strong communicator and collaborator who enjoys working across teams, and you're comfortable in a dynamic platform environment where many engineers depend on what you build and priorities evolve with the business.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.
The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.
We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve the lakehouse: Help build the foundations that let data workflows read and write Iceberg tables directly, from this cycle's MVP to a production-grade platform.
  • Drive adoption: Help migrate data pipelines from across Spotify onto the new stack, making the move as painless as possible through tooling, standards and hands-on support.
  • Own BigQuery at Spotify scale: Manage reservations and capacity, build monitoring and anti-pattern detection, and develop tooling like the BigQuery MCP server so teams can use BigQuery well.
  • Keep the platform healthy: Take part in a weekly support rotation and shared on-call. You'll debug production issues that span storage formats, catalog APIs, Kubernetes reconciliation, GCP IAM and BigQuery internals, and you'll automate away recurring toil.

• You have solid experience building and operating backend services in production with Java or Scala.
  • You're comfortable on GCP and Kubernetes. You can read kubectl output, reason about IAM and quotas, and work with CRDs and operators. You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one.
  • You've worked with Apache Iceberg or JVM-based processing frameworks like Spark, Beam or Flink, or with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Databricks.
  • You think in systems and can connect the dots when a problem crosses several layers of the stack.
  • You like owning things in production, and you're motivated by seeing your systems run reliably for thousands of users.
  • You communicate clearly in writing and work well asynchronously across US and EU time zones.
  • You own the quality of what you ship, including code written with AI assistance.

This role is based in London or Stockholm.
 
We offer the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meeetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

lists.content:

  • Business Development: Proactively identify and cultivate high-potential customer relationships across diverse verticals to grow a robust sales pipeline.

  • Sales Targets: Own and exceed ambitious revenue goals through strategic, entrepreneurial approaches that drive sustainable growth.

  • Product Expertise: Stay ahead of Spotify’s product innovations, identifying cross-selling opportunities to help clients succeed.

  • Pipeline Development: Skillfully manage multiple complex conversations, prioritizing engagements with efficiency using relevant software tools.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Data teams to create comprehensive strategies and optimize platform effectiveness

• Knowledgeable: You bring a minimum of 5+ years of experience managing pipelines and driving revenue in a digital advertising tech environment. Experience in audio advertising and with Agency Holding Companies (Havas, Publicis, WPP, Dentsu, OMC…) are a plus.

  • Articulate: You are an effective communicator, clearly expressing both your stakeholders’ needs and your own.

• This role is based in our London office.

Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies.

You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify.

Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

lists.content:
• Own quarterly and annual revenue targets for your client portfolio, managing your sales pipeline and identifying opportunities for sustainable growth.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with media agencies and advertising clients, understanding their business priorities and positioning Spotify as a valuable strategic partner.
  • Collaborate with agency teams across media buying, strategy, planning, programmatic and branded content to develop effective advertising campaigns.
  • Translate client challenges and business objectives into tailored advertising solutions that deliver measurable results.
  • Develop compelling proposals and respond to client briefs, demonstrating how Spotify's audio, video, display and integrated advertising solutions can support their goals.
  • Partner with internal Sales, Marketing and Product teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience, from initial conversations through to campaign delivery.
  • Build an active network of client relationships through regular meetings, industry engagement and thoughtful account planning.
  • Represent Spotify at industry events, sharing our advertising capabilities, insights and creative opportunities with clients and partners.

• You have 8+ years of experience in advertising sales, business development or client partnerships within digital media.
  • You understand the digital advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising, audio, video and display, and can explain how these channels support different client objectives.
  • You have experience building relationships with advertisers and media agencies in the Australian market, with a track record of growing accounts and delivering against revenue targets.
  • You are familiar with programmatic advertising platforms, including demand-side platforms (DSPs) and supply-side platforms (SSPs).
  • You know how to develop consultative sales strategies, lead commercial negotiations and present ideas that connect with different audiences.
  • You are comfortable using Salesforce to manage client relationships and sales pipelines, as well as Google Slides and Sheets to create presentations and reports.
  • You bring a collaborative, organised and adaptable approach, balancing commercial priorities while building trust with clients and colleagues.
  • You communicate clearly, welcome different perspectives and enjoy finding creative solutions to business challenges. 
  • Experience working with financial services advertisers would be valuable.

• This role is based in Sydney
  • There will be some in person meetings, but there is flexibility to work from home.

description:
Spotify is looking for a culturally fluent, strategically sharp, and creative Communications Lead to shape and share our story across MENAT+. You’ll lead communications across the Middle East, North Africa, Türkiye, and Pakistan, helping Spotify strengthen its reputation, champion regional creators, and show up in ways that feel relevant to the audiences and communities we serve.

Reporting to the Head of Communications, SAMEA, you’ll work closely with regional leadership and Spotify’s global communications teams across consumer, corporate, policy, industry, executive, and internal communications. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines strategic judgment with hands-on execution and knows how to navigate culturally dynamic, fast-moving markets.

lists.content:

Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.

descriptionPlain:
The Music Mission enables music creators to grow, engage, and monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artists and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos, and Clips help artists and their teams grow their audiences, connect with fans, and achieve their goals on Spotify.
We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode within the Music Mission. Discovery Mode is a tool for artists and music marketers designed to help find new listeners when it matters most. With Discovery Mode, artists and labels identify songs that are a priority, and our systems use that signal to inform the algorithms that power personalized recommendations. This role sits within the ML squad that builds and operates the models behind Discovery Mode's measurement system, and you'll serve as the squad's analytical lead.
In this role, you'll partner closely with product managers and ML engineers to evaluate and improve the models that power Discovery Mode. You'll tackle complex analytical problems by designing experiments, developing evaluation frameworks, and building the analytical foundations that help keep our models accurate, reliable, and impactful for artists. As part of the Product Insights team within Music Mission, you'll help shape the measurement systems behind one of Spotify's most important promotion products.

lists.content:
• Own the analytical function for the Discovery Mode ML squad, driving evaluation and continuous improvement of the models that power measurement and campaign optimization
  • Partner with ML engineers to develop evaluation frameworks and identify opportunities to improve model performance, reliability, and customer impact
  • Design and execute rigorous experiments to evaluate model quality, measure outcomes, and guide model development
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to assess model performance and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product and business stakeholders
  • Build, maintain, and evolve dashboards that track model health, customer metrics, and program performance
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and cross-functional partners to align analytical priorities with squad goals and customer needs
  • Contribute to the broader Product Insights community by sharing best practices and helping raise the bar for analytics across Discovery Mode

• You have 4+ years of experience in a data science role and a degree in data science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • You have experience measuring customer outcomes, defining KPIs, and connecting analytical insights to product decisions
  • You know how to design and implement A/B tests, understand when experimentation is the right tool, and interpret results with appropriate rigor
  • You have experience evaluating machine learning model performance and partnering with ML engineers to improve model and customer outcomes
  • You are comfortable working in a highly technical environment and collaborating closely with engineering partners
  • You communicate complex statistical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • You have strong data science fundamentals, including Python, SQL, BigQuery, dbt, data storytelling, and experience working within cross-functional product teams
  • You have experience in areas such as advertising measurement, recommendation systems, experimentation, or causal inference at scale

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EST timezone region as long as we have a work location.
  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

descriptionPlain:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop multiple engineering teams through engineering managers, supporting their growth and impact.
  • Own and drive the technical strategy for a critical platform domain, aligning it with broader company and platform goals.
  • Enable teams across Spotify to build product experiences efficiently by improving the underlying catalog systems.
  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
  • Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.

• You have experience leading engineering organizations through other leaders and scaling teams effectively.
  • You have worked on complex, data-intensive systems where accuracy, consistency, and reliability at scale are critical.
  • You bring strong system design and architectural decision-making experience in distributed systems.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and making thoughtful trade-offs in high-impact environments.
  • You have experience evolving legacy systems and guiding long-term platform transformations.
  • You influence effectively across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • You have experience leading distributed teams and creating alignment across locations.
  • You communicate clearly and can explain complex technical topics to a range of audiences.
  • You are curious about how AI and automation can improve systems and workflows and apply that thinking pragmatically.
  • You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where teams can grow and do their best work.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

categories.team: Advertising Sales - Emerging and Scaled Sales

descriptionPlain:
Spotify's Emerging & Scaled (E&S) business is growing rapidly across the US and Canada, and we're investing in accelerating first-time advertiser growth. As part of our mission to help brands connect with fans through audio and video, we're expanding our New Business organization.

We're looking for an experienced Director of Sales to lead our New Business acquisition strategy across North America. In this role, you'll lead and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team, driving the full sales cycle from prospecting through closing. Reporting to E&S leadership, you'll shape scalable acquisition strategies, strengthen pipeline generation, and create a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching and measurable performance goals. You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

lists.content:
• Define and lead the New Business go-to-market strategy across the US and Canada, expanding Spotify's presence in new and underpenetrated advertiser categories.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team responsible for the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification through negotiation and closing.
  • Build scalable prospecting strategies, outreach frameworks, and repeatable sales processes that accelerate pipeline generation and first-time advertiser acquisition.
  • Foster a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching, clear performance expectations, measurable KPIs, and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Develop and implement sales playbooks, vertical-specific narratives, and performance storytelling that help sellers engage prospective advertisers and convert opportunities into revenue.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales Enablement, Product, and vendor teams to strengthen competitive positioning and develop effective acquisition strategies across Spotify's audio, video, and programmatic advertising solutions.
  • Build relationships with agencies, brands, and senior decision-makers, identifying new opportunities and turning first-time advertisers into long-term partners.
  • Own net-new revenue targets, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and sales performance, using Salesforce and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and continuously improve results.

• You have 10+ years of experience in digital media sales or related B2B industries, including 5+ years leading, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • You have proven experience leading high-velocity, outbound-focused B2B sales teams, ideally within digital advertising, ad tech, SaaS, martech, or performance marketing.
  • You have a strong track record of driving net-new customer acquisition, building scalable prospecting strategies, and leading teams through the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to closed-won business.
  • You know how to build a results-driven sales culture through disciplined pipeline management, measurable KPIs, hands-on coaching, and continuous performance improvement.
  • You have a deep understanding of digital advertising, including direct and programmatic buying, measurement, advertising technology, and data-driven solutions.
  • You have experience setting and delivering ambitious new-business revenue targets, using pipeline metrics, conversion data, and sales forecasting to guide decisions and improve performance.
  • You know how to build trusted relationships with senior agency and brand decision-makers, understand their business challenges, and communicate the value of advertising solutions.
  • You are an inclusive, collaborative leader who enjoys developing talent, building strong teams, and partnering across functions to achieve shared goals.

• This role is based in New York
  • We ask that you come into the New York office 2-3 times per week.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers.
  • Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure.
  • Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale.
  • Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies.
  • Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services.
  • Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities.

• You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility.
  • You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression.
  • You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team.
  • You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity.
  • You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones.
  • You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room.
  • You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

• This role is based in London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
Think it, build it, ship it, tweak it" is at the core of Spotify's product development approach. In the Experimentation product area we are providing Spotify and external customers with Confidence, our platform to quickly and safely iterate through ideas, learn from them and make informed decisions for better products.
 
At Spotify, experimentation touches almost all of our functions from marketing via content management to consumer products, and we’re running several thousands of tests every year. Through confidence, we 're sharing all our findings and practices with more companies as a commercial SaaS product.
 
The team you will manage is a skilled and highly engaged group of engineers that are distributed over Europe. As an Engineering manager, you coach them individually and as a team, maintaining their strong team culture and helping them thrive and and grow. Your technical experience provides mentorship and guidelines to the team, which ensures quality and timeliness of your deliveries. Your leadership promotes creativity, collaboration and courage, which forms a kind and productive team with a high bar for quality and pace of delivery.

descriptionPlain:
Music Expression builds the tools artists use to show who they are on Spotify and to connect with fans. A song doesn't have to be just a track in a list. On Spotify it can come with a looping Canvas visual, a music video, a vertical-video clip from the artist, or a countdown to a new release. Release day can become a shared Listening Party. Every one of those things was built by this org. Each squad owns part of the artist-to-fan journey.
The work runs from video pipelines and serving infrastructure through mobile and web clients to rights systems, so engineers get real depth and range. Product, design, data science, research and product marketing work inside the squads, and they work directly with artists and labels. What you ship changes how artists show up on Spotify and how fans experience their music. If you want to work where technology meets creativity and culture, this is the place.
If this role excites you but you don't meet every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify's in-house creative studio, Reverb, brings our brand to life through thoughtful design, visual storytelling, and creative production. Working across brand and communications, the team creates work that connects with audiences around the world.
We're looking for a Global Creative Lead to shape the visual direction of Reverb and lead a talented team of graphic designers, motion designers, and producers. You'll combine creative vision with hands-on leadership, helping the team deliver distinctive, high-quality work while building an environment where people can collaborate, experiment, and grow.
Reporting to the Director, Global Experiential & Content Production, you'll play a key role in shaping the studio's creative output and how we work together.

lists.content:
• Lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 graphic designers, motion designers, and producers, supporting their creative growth and career development.

    • Shape the visual and motion design direction across Reverb projects, creating distinctive work that brings Spotify's brand and stories to life.

    • Partner with teams across brand, communications, marketing, and production to turn creative briefs into engaging visual experiences across channels and formats.

    • Guide creative development from concept through delivery, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and thoughtful design decisions.

    • Manage project intake, priorities, budgets, timelines, and resources to help the team deliver meaningful work across multiple projects.

    • Collaborate with Reverb's creative and production leads to build a connected, effective studio and a consistent creative experience.

    • Present creative concepts and recommendations to senior stakeholders, explaining the thinking behind decisions and building alignment.

    • Work with internal teams and external creative partners to maintain design quality, manage production needs, and navigate relevant legal and licensing requirements.

• You bring 8+ years of experience in graphic design, visual design, or a related creative discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating strong visual storytelling, brand identity, and motion design.

  • You have 4+ years of experience leading creative teams, with a thoughtful approach to coaching, feedback, and helping others develop their craft.

  • You're comfortable shaping creative direction across digital, social, advertising, editorial, and long-form brand content, adapting your approach to different audiences and formats.

  • You have experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma, and relevant visual or motion design tools, and you're curious about how emerging technologies can support the creative process.

  • You know how to balance creative ambition with practical delivery, making thoughtful decisions around timelines, budgets, and resources.

  • You communicate creative ideas clearly and enjoy collaborating with designers, producers, and partners across different disciplines and regions.

  • You have experience working with external creative studios, production companies, and partners, including managing budgets, contracts, and production workflows.

  • You care about creating an inclusive, supportive team environment where different perspectives are valued, feedback is welcomed, and people can do their best work.

• This role is based in New York City.

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! We ask that you come into the office 1-2x per week.

descriptionPlain:
Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets.

Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

lists.content:
• Lead Spotify's growth strategy in Japan, driving Premium subscriber acquisition, conversion, retention and revenue performance.
  • Own and deliver the Premium growth plan, identifying opportunities across the customer journey and translating them into measurable business outcomes.
  • Work closely with Marketing, Music and Partnerships leadership to shape growth priorities based on consumer insights, market trends and competitive dynamics.
  • Partner with our Partnerships team to unlock subscriber growth through telecommunications, device, payment and content partners.
  • Design and run experiments across paid, owned and in-app channels, using data and clear success metrics to improve conversion and retention.
  • Develop CRM and lifecycle marketing strategies across email, push notifications and in-app messaging, creating relevant experiences that engage and retain listeners.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Payments and Finance teams to build business cases, evaluate performance and identify scalable growth opportunities.
  • Lead and develop a team member, share learnings with regional Growth teams and explore how AI-powered tools can improve decision-making and execution.

• You have experience driving growth in a digital consumer business, such as streaming, entertainment, e-commerce or consumer technology.
  • You have a track record of owning subscriber or commercial growth targets and understand how acquisition, conversion and retention contribute to sustainable growth.
  • You're experienced in digital marketing, CRM and lifecycle campaigns, with the ability to turn customer insights into meaningful action.
  • You're confident using data, analytics tools and experimentation to make decisions, evaluate performance and identify opportunities. Familiarity with SQL can help you go further.
  • You understand subscription business economics, including customer lifetime value, subscriber acquisition cost and gross margin.
  • You combine analytical thinking with creative marketing instincts and a strong understanding of Japanese consumer behaviour and culture.
  • You're comfortable collaborating across functions, influencing stakeholders and taking ownership of initiatives in a fast-moving environment.
  • You enjoy developing others, are curious about using AI to improve how you work, and communicate fluently in Japanese and confidently in business English.
  • Please apply to this role with your CV/Resume in English

• This role is based in Tokyo
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

  • Stepping in and executing alongside or in place of functions when needed

    • Business Planning:

  • Working with the Managing Director, Japan and functional leads to formulate local strategy in line with Spotify’s overall global strategy
  • Owning and adapting the regional planning process and framework
  • Ensuring that the plan takes into account all necessary local and global functions and addresses both local challenges and global priorities

    • Business Reviews and Reporting:

  • Driving operations for the region by building efficiency, removing obstacles and improving processes
  • Providing the functions with the insights and knowledge needed to drive decisions and define strategy
  • Ensuring communication and alignment between all functions, including Music, Podcasts, Marketing, Growth, Finance, Ad Sales, PR, and HR
  • Communicating and aligning with global stakeholders, including but not limited to the Global functions in Markets & Subscriptions

• A minimum of 8-12+ years work experience, including an early or growth stage internet company and/or top-tier management consultancy, and experience working with an international team
  • Passionate and have a deep understanding of the technology and music spaces
  • Familiar with Japanese popular culture, the Japanese business landscape and Japanese consumer behavior
  • Thought leader with proven results demonstrating business judgment
  • General business skills, equally comfortable analyzing data, coordinating internal projects, speaking to partners, or negotiating a deal
  • Organized, process-driven strategic thinker with an understanding of planning and budgeting
  • Analytical expert, developing and interpreting deep data analysis and presenting rigorous analysis and insights with simplicity, clarity, and confidence
  • Rapid and effective decision-making skills

  • Confident, friendly, supportive verbal manner and inquiry
  • Ability to manage internal stakeholders and align teams even with diverse levels of seniority and tenure
  • Genuine, confident, flexible, and fun attitude
  • You thrive from working in a constantly-changing but always-exciting environment!
  • Bilingual in English and Japanese

• This role is based in Tokyo

descriptionPlain:
Spotify is building the next generation of advertising, connecting brands with audiences through audio, video, and experiences that are deeply embedded in people's lives. As our advertising business evolves, demonstrating the impact of advertising on Spotify, and helping advertisers achieve better outcomes, will be critical to our long-term success.
We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.
Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

We are seeking a Head of Measurement & Advertising Effectiveness to define how Spotify proves the value of its advertising, advances measurement science, and makes advertiser effectiveness a lasting competitive advantage.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Advertising, you will be a member of the global Advertising leadership team, operating within a business with end-to-end P&L accountability. You will play an influential role in shaping our strategy, guiding investment priorities, and strengthening the value we deliver to advertisers.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a differentiated measurement and effectiveness organization at a time when the industry is being reshaped by AI, evolving privacy expectations, and increasing demand for measurable business outcomes. We are looking for a leader who combines scientific rigor, strategic vision, commercial judgment, and exceptional people leadership—and who can represent Spotify as a credible and influential voice in the industry.

lists.content:
• Build and transform the function. Set Spotify’s global measurement and effectiveness vision across brand, performance, and full-funnel advertising, and fundamentally build and elevate our capabilities to get there.
  • Advance measurement science. Lead our approach to incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, marketing mix modeling, and brand lift, and set rigorous standards for how we measure advertiser outcomes.
  • Define what we need to prove. Set the scientific requirements for measuring advertising impact on Spotify, and influence investment priorities with Product, Engineering, and Data Science, who own building the solutions.
  • Turn evidence into advertiser growth. Build marketing science and consulting capabilities that help advertisers understand and improve their results on Spotify, and partner with commercial leaders to turn that evidence into deeper relationships and smarter investment decisions.
  • Tailor measurement by industry. Develop approaches that reflect the distinct goals and challenges of advertisers in key verticals.
  • Build research and partnerships. Set an ambitious research agenda, develop relationships with leading measurement and technology partners, and advance independent validation and new approaches.
  • Lead what’s next. Anticipate how AI, new methods, and ecosystem shifts will change measurement, and position Spotify to lead rather than follow.
  • Shape industry thinking. Go beyond representing Spotify to help shape how the industry approaches effectiveness and measurement standards, through direct engagement with CMOs and agency leaders, seats on industry boards, major conference stages, and thought leadership.
  • Build an exceptional organization. Design, scale, and lead a high-performing global team spanning measurement strategy, marketing science, advertiser consulting, research, and partnerships.
  • Shape Advertising leadership decisions. Bring scientific expertise, advertiser insight, and an evidence-based perspective to the leadership team’s strategic choices and long-term priorities.

• You’re an accomplished senior leader in advertising measurement, marketing science, or advertiser effectiveness, ideally at a leading ad platform, technology company, or measurement organization.
  • You have a track record of setting strategy, building or transforming capabilities, and delivering impact at scale.
  • You have deep expertise in incrementality, causal inference, experimentation, attribution, and marketing effectiveness, and the judgment to weigh each method’s strengths, limits, and practical uses.
  • You understand how advertisers make investment decisions and how measurement drives media allocation, confidence, and growth.
  • You pair scientific rigor with commercial thinking, turning complex evidence into clear priorities, compelling narratives, and actionable recommendations.
  • You understand the product, data, technology, and privacy factors shaping modern measurement, and you’ve successfully influenced cross-functional investments.
  • You’re excited by the measurement challenges of audio, video, and podcasts: formats where traditional click-based attribution falls short.
  • You have a forward-looking view of how AI and evolving industry standards will reshape advertising effectiveness.
  • You’ve built and led multidisciplinary organizations, attracting exceptional talent and developing strong senior leaders.
  • You’re a compelling communicator with the executive presence to engage C-suite advertisers, agencies, and industry bodies, and to make sophisticated measurement concepts clear and relevant to business leaders.
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments, challenge conventional thinking, and balance long-term ambition with near-term delivery.

• This role is based in New York
  • We ask that you come into the office 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain:
Spotify's Legal team is growing. We're facing innovative challenges that mirror the groundbreaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we've expanded into more than 180 markets and our business has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day — including an increasing volume of patent disputes alongside the copyright and content matters that have always been central to our work.
As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. The work we face is constantly developing, and the workload is growing faster than we can, so we will look to you to think thoughtfully about processes and policies that will help meet our goals. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial. Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

lists.content:
• Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.

• You hold a law degree (or equivalent) from a top-flight law school and are qualified to practice law as in-house counsel in the State of New York.
  • You have 5+ years of litigation experience at a law firm, in-house, or both, including meaningful experience with copyright litigation.
  • You have experience with e-discovery and managing complex, multi-jurisdictional disputes.
  • You have experience contributing to teams that drive successful outcomes on complex matters.
  • You have a demonstrated ability to evaluate copyright claims, work with technical experts, and develop defense strategies.
  • You have a passion for solving legal problems and can explain legal concepts — including technical copyright issues — to non-lawyers.
  • You are comfortable working with large data sets and technical subject matter; you may not be an engineer, but you can speak the language and understand the concepts.
  • You are a problem solver who can stay calm when problems come your way.
  • You have excellent judgment — you can think a problem through when you need to, but have also developed instincts that you can trust.
  • You are self-motivated and can identify and complete work that needs to be done without being instructed.
  • You can advocate for a position while balancing risk and multiple colleagues' and business considerations.
  • You can balance many simultaneous tasks and triage to make sure the right matters get your attention.
  • You're willing to roll up your sleeves and dig in on projects.
  • You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal business partners.
  • You have very effective written and oral communication skills.
  • Knowledge of music, media, tech, IP, and/or consumer issues is a plus.
  • A technical background or experience with software, streaming, or audio technology patents is a plus but not required.

• Onsite: (For example: You’ll be based in our New York office)
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

descriptionPlain:
At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.
Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.
We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.
Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

lists.content:
• Lead multi-week ML initiatives end to end, from translating business requirements into technical specifications to shipping models and measuring their impact on subscriber metrics
  • Own components of our ML systems, making independent technical trade-offs and keeping them observable, reliable, and well documented
  • Collaborate with a multi-functional agile team spanning user research, design, data science, product management, and engineering to build new product features that advance our mission to connect artists and fans in personalised and relevant ways
  • Prototype new approaches and productionise solutions at scale for our hundreds of millions of active users
  • Help drive optimisation, testing, and tooling to improve quality
  • Unblock and share context with your teammates to raise the whole squad's velocity
  • Use AI-assisted engineering to move faster and remove repetitive toil, while owning the quality of everything you ship
  • Partner closely with senior and staff ML engineers, and be part of an active group of machine learning practitioners in your mission and across Spotify

• You have experience building and shipping production ML systems
  • You have a strong background in machine learning, theory, and practice
  • You are comfortable explaining the intuition and assumptions behind ML concepts
  • You can own well-scoped ML projects end to end and make sound technical decisions independently
  • You communicate clearly with stakeholders and can explain the reasoning behind your technical choices
  • You are curious, open to feedback, and keen to grow your scope over time
  • You have hands-on experience implementing and maintaining production ML systems in Python, Scala, or similar languages, including model development with PyTorch
  • You are experienced with building data pipelines, and you are self-sufficient in getting the data you need to build and evaluate your models
  • You preferably have experience with cloud platforms like GCP or AWS
  • You care about agile software processes, data development, reliability, and focused experimentation
  • You have a desire to drive business impact

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location

  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.
